welcome:
Assalamu alaikum, {name}! 🌙

I'm Zikr Circle. I help your Telegram group keep a daily worship challenge together — zikr, prayers, Qur'an — with gentle reminders and a nightly summary.

Add me to your group, then a group admin runs /setup.
bot_added:
Assalamu alaikum! 🤝 Thank you for adding Zikr Circle.

A group admin should run /setup to become the challenge owner and choose the goals. Everyone else can run /join.
group_only: Please use this command inside a group.
setup_not_admin: Only a group admin can run /setup.
setup_owned_by_other: This group's challenge was already set up by {owner}. Only the owner can change its settings.
setup_done:
✅ {name} is now the owner of this group's challenge.

Tap the button to choose goals and times. Members can join with /join.
anonymous_admin: I can't tell who you are while you post anonymously. Turn off "Remain anonymous" in your admin rights and try again.
anonymous_join: Please post as yourself (not anonymously) to /join.
join_done: ✅ {name} joined the challenge. May Allah accept it!
morning_footer: Log your progress in the app 👇
night_nobody: No progress logged today. Tomorrow is a new start, in shaa Allah 🤲
night_footer: May Allah accept from all of us 🤲
today_not_member: You haven't joined this challenge yet. Send /join first.
today_no_goals: This group has no goals yet. The owner can add them with /setup.
